title: Engine install screen strobes between "preparing dependencies" and the download progress
description: Reported live by the user during the Linux engine install, 2026-07-30 (MPI-391 section D). Cosmetic - the install completes - and the user said they were not worried; filed so it is not lost. Symptom: the screen is stable, then rapidly alternates between a "preparing dependencies" label state and a byte-counting download state, then goes stable again, during the dependency phase. UNVERIFIED candidate cause: _provisionUvEngine broadcasts two different event shapes - engine:extracting with a status label and engine:downloading with downloadedBytes/totalBytes - and if both interleave while uv/pip resolves and fetches, the install screen would flip between the label view and the byte view on every event. Not traced; do not fix from the card alone. Worth fixing because it reads as instability on the first screen a new user watches for many minutes on a slow machine.
